description: List every user in a Canvas account — every role the account contains, not only students — optionally filtered by `search_term` matching name, email, or login. Fetches every page (100 per request) and fails with a 'Results are incomplete' error instead of silently truncating. Use `include` to add email, last_login, avatar_url, time_zone, or uuid to each returned user, `sort`/`order` to control result ordering (`sort: "id"` is Canvas's recommended choice when paging through many results), and `list_course_users` to scope the roster to one course rather than the whole account. When CANVAS_PSEUDONYMIZE_STUDENTS is enabled, every returned user's name and contact info is replaced with a stable pseudonym — this tool has no enrollment data to tell students from staff, so every row is masked the same way; use `resolve_pseudonym` to map one back to a real user_id. Requires an admin role on the account.

include.description: Extra fields to include on each user (Canvas include[] param)

search_term.description: Search users by name, email, or login

sort.description: Sort field. Use "id" for efficient pagination through many pages of results.
